title: Actress Ananya Raj Dies at 27, Known for Ghost and Thaggede Le
excerpt: The Lucknow-born actress, who appeared in Vikram Bhatt's Ghost and the Telugu thriller Thaggede Le, passed away after reportedly battling physical and mental health challenges.
body:
• Actress Ananya Raj, known for films including Ghost (2019), Thaggede Le (2022), and 7 Hours to Go (2016), has passed away at the age of 27.
  • Born in Lucknow and raised in Mumbai, Raj worked across Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil cinema as well as streaming platforms.
  • She reportedly passed away after battling physical and mental discomfort, though exact details have not been disclosed by her family.
  • Raj had won best actor awards at the Golden Sparrow International Film Festival and Port Blair International Film Festival for her short films.

A Career Cut Short

Actress Ananya Raj, also known as Ananya Sengupta, has died at the age of 27, according to reports from the Times of India, Inshorts, and Mid-Day. The actress, who built a diverse career spanning Bollywood, south Indian cinema, and digital platforms, reportedly passed away after battling physical and mental health challenges.

https://x.com/TimesNow/status/2088980298126237805

Raj began her career in 2016 with the Hindi thriller 7 Hours to Go and went on to appear in Dhwanil Mehta's The Final Exit (2017). Her breakout role came in Vikram Bhatt's supernatural horror film Ghost (2019), where her portrayal of Sonia earned praise from critics and audiences.

From Bollywood to South Indian Cinema

In 2022, Raj expanded into regional cinema with the Telugu crime thriller Thaggede Le, directed by Srinivas Raju. The film, which also starred Naveen Chandra and Divya Pillai, was released on Amazon Prime Video. She also appeared in the Tamil film Madrasi Gang and featured in the TV series City of Dreams.

Beyond feature films, Raj was active in short films and music videos. Her performances in the shorts Enigma and Silver Gandhi won her back-to-back best actor awards at the Golden Sparrow International Film Festival and the Port Blair International Film Festival respectively.

Early Life and Background

Born in 1998 in Lucknow, Raj was raised in Mumbai. She enrolled in an acting school after completing her 12th-grade education, which led her to join a theatre group. She started as a model before transitioning into acting, working her way through independent films and gradually building a presence across multiple film industries.

According to interviews she gave during her career, Raj spoke candidly about the challenges of breaking into south Indian cinema as an outsider. "Working in the south film industry isn't easy like many people believe," she told the National Herald in 2022.

Industry Tributes

News of her passing has prompted tributes from colleagues in the Indian film industry. At 27, Raj's death represents the loss of a young talent who was still in the early stages of what appeared to be a promising career spanning multiple languages and formats.

The exact circumstances of her death have not been publicly disclosed by her family, with reports stating she had been dealing with physical and mental discomfort in the period before her passing.
